text:
maria: Hey team — dropping the latest hero + benchmark blurb for the product launch blog. Need copy ✅ and legal quick-pass. Draft below, pls react with :thumbsup: or edits.

alex: sharing spreadsheet with numbers? need the raw curve so we can cite 95th pct.

maria: yep — sheet: https://tiny.redwood/bench-lift (view only). Topline: '3x lower token cost and 60% lower tail latency vs our previous hosted baseline.'

jonah: quick thought — "3x lower token cost" may read like price comparison. can we say "up to 3x lower per-token cost" instead? less definitive.

maria: good call. new hero: "Up to 3x lower per-token cost and 60% lower 95th-percentile latency vs our hosted baseline."

sarah: tagging webinar planning — we should tie the claim to the demo: slide 3 will show end-to-end qps + real-time tracing. webinar date still Tue 3/26?

maria: yes Tue 3/26 at 10am PT. Can we reserve 250 seats and a waitlist?

alex: ops note — reserve 250, enable waitlist. HubSpot mapping below:

```json
{
  "utm_source": "launch_post",
  "utm_medium": "blog",
  "utm_campaign": "prod_lift_lab",
  "hs_lead_status": "marketing_engaged",
  "tags": ["launch_2026","lift_lab_demo"]
}
```

jonah: legal-bot — can you run a quick sweep on the benchmark phrasing? We linked the methodology tab in the sheet.

legal-bot: Automated check: please add the dataset/method line to the post and avoid absolute superlatives without qualification. Suggested append: "Benchmark methodology: internal A/B runs on c5g and p4d-equivalent hardware; see methodology tab for test harness, datasets, and warmup details."

maria: inserting that language. Also adding CTA to register for the webinar and a link to the eval notebook.

alex: small copy tweak for CTA: "Register to see the end-to-end demo and get the benchmark notebook."

maria: updated. New blog excerpt: 

"Today we’re shipping Lift Lab — a serving configuration that can reduce per-token cost by up to 3x and cut 95th-percentile latency by ~60% compared to our previous hosted baseline. Benchmark methodology: internal A/B runs across representative workloads; see methodology tab for details. Register to see the end-to-end demo and get the benchmark notebook."

jonah: LGTM from PM side. :rocket:

sarah: webinar ops — putting draft invite in calendar, linking demo cluster, Q&A slot reserved. Who’s moderating?

maria: I’ll moderate, jonah to do the live demo, alex for Q&A.

legal-bot: Manual review required for the phrase "reduce per-token cost by up to 3x" — legal ops will respond in-thread within 48h with final signoff or edit suggestions.

maria: thanks. next steps: 1) legal quick-pass, 2) finalize hero image, 3) lock HubSpot UTMs and registration form. Pls ack.

alex: ack, will lock UTMs and confirm seat counts by EOD.

jonah: ack — prepping demo checklist.

sarah: ack — calendar invite + webinar room setup in progress.

maria: thanks team — will hold until legal OK then send to publishing queue. :white_check_mark:
